site_surface.short_summary: Jeskai Way is a source-authored, review-gated Tarkir wedge packet for Blue-centered cunning, disciplined martial practice, Red action, White structure, Khans-era monasteries and Ways, Narset and Shu Yun timeline boundaries, Ojutai discontinuity, and modern Dragonstorm revival boundaries.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Jeskai perfects the self until insight can move with precision, courage, and shared restraint.
site_surface.tagline: Know the line. Train the body. Move when insight is ready.
best_for: readers drawn to discipline, precision, martial study, insight, restrained action, and source-bound Tarkir clan identity
players who like spells, prowess-like tempo, protection, copies, artifacts, energy, cycling, or time counters as support-only Commander vocabulary
reviewers checking that Jeskai stays separate from generic color-code metadata, Ojutai continuity, seed files, generated HTML, Commander products, unsupported mechanics, and runtime promotion
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Jeskai material can involve martial hierarchy, clan erasure, dragonlord oppression, religious or philosophical conflict, and timeline discontinuity. This packet keeps exact mechanics, card facts, Commander legality, full Narset or Shu Yun biographies, complete six-fire doctrine, and complete three-Ways hierarchy deferred.

core_identity.identity_statement: Jeskai Way is Blue-centered cunning through disciplined action: Blue pursues perfection through knowledge and training, Red turns insight into action, and White gives that action shared form and restraint.
core_identity.identity_source: VM-229 evidence rows shaped by VM-230 and VM-231 architecture sections.
core_identity.notes: This is profile wording only. The raw claims remain tied to VM-229 evidence rows, and JESKAI is a future/planned expression name only.

structure.primary_structure: Khans-era Jeskai Way is a monastery-centered clan of monks, sages, martial artists, mystics, and wandering warriors with discipline, enlightenment, honor, respect, strongholds, schools, elders, Annals, Rules of Reeds, and three major Ways.
structure.modern_structure: Modern Dragonstorm-era Jeskai is a revived, timeline-labeled clan led by Way practitioners, with disciplined thought, shared reality, precision, compassion, martial training, eastern mountain monasteries, Shu Yun writings, and a rejection of Ojutai reincarnation doctrine.
timeline_boundaries: Khans-era Jeskai Way is the main Jeskai floor.
Fate Reforged Shu Yun material is transition context only.
Dragons-era Ojutai is a boundary and discontinuity, not direct Khans-era Jeskai continuity.
Modern Dragonstorm Jeskai is revived-clan context and cannot be backfilled into Khans-era doctrine.

great_tension.summary: Jeskai's disciplined cunning can become brittle certainty if practice turns into doctrine without compassion, humility, or era boundaries.
great_tension.positive_expression: Insight trained into precise action, shared restraint, and martial excellence.
great_tension.failure_mode: Generic URW/WUR color-code identity, Ojutai continuity, Dragonstorm backfill, unsupported mechanics, or Commander goodstuff without a Jeskai evidence cluster.

historical_timeline.summary: Monks, sages, lake-top monasteries, mystical arts, martial artists, mystics, wandering warriors, discipline, enlightenment, fire-language, strongholds, elders, schools, Annals, Rules of Reeds, three Ways, and Narset as era-bound leader.
Shu Yun leads a Jeskai clan of martial artists and mystics, with memory, Annals, and Ojutai confrontation carried only as transition context.
Ojutai clan is a separate later structure and a discontinuity boundary, not direct Khans-era Jeskai Way continuity.
Revived Jeskai with Way practitioners, eastern mountain monasteries, Shu Yun writings, rejection of Ojutai reincarnation doctrine, and distinct practice language.
